VISUAL REVIEW FOUND AND FIXED A REAL DEFECT. First screenshots showed the lifted block unstyled inside the dialog: checkbox above its label, Appearance and Palette labels inline, rows cramped. Cause: every .settings-field / .settings-check / .settings-form / .settings-section layout rule lives in src/research/research.css scoped under .project-settings, which the dialog body did not have. Fix: the dialog body now carries .project-settings as well, so the shared rules apply unchanged, and library.css overrides only the frame (no page padding, page width, scroll container or top rule under a heading the dialog already carries) and widens the dialog to 560 px, because the shared 180 px + 12 + 260 px field grid cannot fit a 420 px dialog. The width rule uses .dialog:has(.library-settings-body); on an engine without :has the dialog stays 420 px and the control column shrinks (it is minmax(0, 260px)), so nothing overflows. Re-ran the full acceptance after the fix: tsc 0, build 0, 58 passed. Viewed at 2x: ui3-a4/shots/projects-light.png, projects-dark.png, settings-dialog-light.png, settings-dialog-dark.png, plus settings-destination-light.png and settings-destination-dark.png proving the General block in its original home is unchanged (heading, top rule, Sidebar and Goals below all intact). The gear needs no new styling: S1's icon-button selector list already covers .library-display > button, so it matches the sort and view buttons.

DESIGN DOC (for D2/T150). Settings has one General block, defined once and shown in two places: the Settings destination and a Settings dialog opened from the gear at the right of the Projects screen's display row. The dialog reuses the destination's field grid rather than a second layout, so the two cannot drift; the dialog is 560 px wide to hold the 180 px label column and 260 px control column, hides the block's own heading because the dialog title carries it, and drops the section's top rule and page padding. The dialog closes on Escape or Close and returns focus to the gear. Project settings (Sidebar, Goals) stay in the destination and never appear in the dialog. The gear is an icon button and follows the icon-button recipe.

App.tsx and ProjectLibrary.tsx are now free for T148 (K2) and T149 (N4).
